from gecko_tls import Session, AsyncSession, StreamResponse
import asyncio

print\('=== 1. Streaming Response ==='\)
s = Session\('chrome', timeout=15\)
stream = s.stream_get\('https://www.google.com/', headers={
    'accept': 'text/html',
    'accept-encoding': 'identity',
}\)
print\(f'type: {type\(stream\).__name__}'\)
print\(f'status: {stream.status_code}'\)
print\(f'http_version: {stream.http_version}'\)
print\(f'content-type: {stream.headers.get\(\\"content-type\\", \\"N/A\\"\)}'\)

total = 0
chunk_count = 0
for chunk in stream:
    total += len\(chunk\)
    chunk_count += 1
print\(f'chunks: {chunk_count}, total_bytes: {total}'\)

print\(\)
print\('=== 2. stream read_all\(\) ==='\)
stream2 = s.stream_get\('https://httpbin.org/get', headers={
    'accept': 'application/json',
    'accept-encoding': 'identity',
}\)
body = stream2.read_all\(\)
print\(f'read_all type: {type\(body\).__name__}, len: {len\(body\)}'\)
print\(f'body preview: {body[:100]}'\)

print\(\)
print\('=== 3. Request Counter ==='\)
print\(f'request_count after tests: {s.request_count}'\)
s.get\('https://httpbin.org/get', headers={'accept-encoding': 'identity'}\)
print\(f'request_count after +1 get: {s.request_count}'\)

print\(\)
print\('=== 4. AsyncSession ==='\)
async def test_async\(\):
    a = AsyncSession\('chrome', timeout=15\)
    r1, r2 = await asyncio.gather\(
        a.get\('https://httpbin.org/get', headers={'accept-encoding': 'identity'}\),
        a.get\('https://www.google.com/', headers={'accept-encoding': 'identity'}\),
    \)
    print\(f'async r1: {r1.status_code} {r1.http_version}'\)
    print\(f'async r2: {r2.status_code} {r2.http_version}'\)
    print\(f'async request_count: {a.request_count}'\)

asyncio.run\(test_async\(\)\)
print\(\)
print\('All tests passed!'\)
" 2>&1)
